payload.reason: The sensitivity study was conducted to explore extreme scenarios regarding the fate of macroalgal biomass, specifically to assess the implications of zero remineralization on carbon storage and nutrient dynamics in marine ecosystems.

claims.text: The sensitivity study tested an extreme scenario where all macroalgal biomass is permanently buried upon reaching the seafloor, simulating zero remineralization.
This approach helps estimate the range of possible fates of remineralized organic matter and its impact on nutrient availability in the ocean.
The study also aimed to evaluate the carbon dioxide removal potential of macroalgal sinking without the side effects of remineralization on marine ecosystems.
